gloopie.title: Create your own
gloopie.promptHelp: A gloopie is a little animated character. Name an object or character and we'll make one for this agent.
gloopie.generatingBody: This can take a little while. Keep working — even in other chats — and this will be right where you left it. We'll tell you when your options are ready.
gloopie.animatingBody: Adding movement can take a few minutes. Keep working — even in other chats — and this will be right where you left it. We'll tell you when it's ready.
gloopie.confirmCancelBody: This stops the current attempt and deletes anything it generated. Your description is kept so you can start again.
gloopie.confirmStartOverBody: This throws away what was generated. Your description is kept so you can try again.
gloopie.backgroundGeneratingBody:
Keep working — even in other chats.
We'll let you know when your options are ready.
gloopie.backgroundAnimatingBody:
Keep working — even in other chats.
We'll let you know when your avatar is ready.
gloopie.backgroundOptionsReadyBody:
Choose one to animate.
You can regenerate if none feel right.
gloopie.chooseHelp:
Choose one to animate.
You can regenerate if none feel right.
gloopie.errorNetwork: This feature needs your work VPN (Cloudflare WARP). Turn it on, then try again.
gloopie.errorContentBlocked: That description couldn't be used. Try describing a physical object or character.
gloopie.errorUnavailable: The gloopie creator couldn't finish that request. Try again or change your description.

empty.aboutDescription: An agent is a focused helper you give a job to - it uses tools, follows instructions, and works through tasks on its own so you don't have to babysit it.
empty.valueTitle: What can it do for me?
empty.valueDescription: Hand off the repetitive or fiddly stuff - researching, drafting, organizing files, calling APIs, running multi-step workflows - and get back results instead of a to-do list.
